map.驾驶镜选型：按场景（昼/夜/雨雾/强光）确定可见光透光率 VLT、镜片分类（0: Driving lens selection: determine the visible light transmittance VLT, lens category (0 to 4) and tint scheme by scenario (day/night/rain-fog/strong light); night driving should keep a high VLT to avoid dimmed vision.
map.夜间驾驶严禁使用深色太阳镜（VLT<75%），会严重影响视野和反应速度。: Dark sunglasses (VLT<75%) are strictly prohibited for night driving, as they severely affect vision and reaction speed.
map.偏振镜片通过偏振膜过滤特定方向的反射光（如路面、水面、车窗眩光），偏振轴通常为垂: Polarized lenses filter reflected light in a specific direction via a polarizing film (such as glare from roads, water and car windows); the polarizing axis is usually vertical (90°), effectively eliminating horizontal-surface glare.
map.UV400表示可阻挡波长400nm以下全部紫外线（UVA+UVB），是驾驶镜的基: UV400 means it blocks all ultraviolet below 400 nm (UVA+UVB), a basic requirement for driving lenses. Long-term UV exposure increases the risk of cataracts.
map.减反射膜(AR Coating)减少镜片表面反射光，提高透光率3%-8%，夜间驾: An anti-reflection coating (AR) reduces surface reflection and improves transmittance by 3%-8%; at night it reduces glare interference from oncoming headlights.
map.欧洲EN ISO 12312-1标准规定驾驶用太阳镜透光率不低于3类(8%-18: The European EN ISO 12312-1 standard requires driving sunglasses to have a transmittance no lower than Category 3 (8%-18%), and Category 4 (3%-8%) is strictly prohibited for driving.
map.驾驶镜选择需综合考虑光照条件、天气和路况，建议常备日间和夜间两副镜片交替使用。: Driving lens selection requires considering lighting conditions, weather and road conditions; keep both a daytime and a nighttime pair for alternating use.
map.驾驶镜片优化夜视与眩光（染色/增透/偏振）。: Driving lenses optimize night vision and glare (tint/AR/polarization).
map.选合适底色与偏光减对面车灯晃眼。: Choose an appropriate base tint and polarization to reduce glare from oncoming headlights.
map.选淡黄/透明+多层增透减少眩光，避免深色片（夜间更暗）；散光者轴位精准否则重影。: Choose light yellow/clear + multilayer AR to reduce glare and avoid dark lenses (darker at night); astigmatism requires precise axis to avoid ghosting.
map.偏光片消路面/水面反光，轴位 0°/90° 视光源；隧道明暗突变处注意亮度适应。: Polarized lenses eliminate road/water reflections, with the axis at 0°/90° depending on the light source; pay attention to brightness adaptation at abrupt light-dark transitions in tunnels.
map.驾驶能用深色吗？: Can dark lenses be used for driving?
map.白天可，夜间/隧道禁深染；以透光率达标（昼≥75%、夜尽量高）为先。: Yes for daytime, but dark tint is prohibited at night/in tunnels; prioritize meeting the transmittance requirement (≥75% daytime, as high as possible at night).
map.只让特定振动方向光过，滤掉偏振化的路面反光，但看 LCD 仪表可能变暗需留意。: It transmits only light of a specific vibration direction and filters out polarized road reflections, but LCD dashboards may appear darker and need attention.
